title: Why it was done this way
intro: A decision records a choice between real alternatives together with its reason. An entry is never edited or deleted; a later decision supersedes an earlier one and both stay readable.

scenarios.title: Recording a decision with its reason

stdout_contains: recorded: refuse tabs in the parser

scenarios.explain: The task id and the git head are computed and attached, so a decision can always be placed against the state of the repository when it was taken.

scenarios.title: Reading them back
scenarios.explain: The reason is part of the record, not a commit message someone may or may not have written. A decision without one is the thing a later worker cannot safely revisit.
